_help: Which frameworks are in scope for this product. gen_compliance.py loads the matching frameworks/<id>.json catalogs. Keep this list to what you actually attest to.
_freshness_help: SOC 2 Type II only: a control whose newest evidence timestamp is older than this many days is flagged 'stale' (operating-effectiveness gap).
_planned_help: If true, --check-gaps fails on any applicable control still in 'planned'. Start false (design phase), flip true before an audit window.
